We have bulk Si structure (mp-149) and CO2 structure (mp-644607). Need to generate slab from Si with Miller (1,1,1), min_slab_size 12, min_vacuum_size 5. Then enumerate slabs, choose slab index 0. Then get adsorption sites, choose ontop site index 0. Then add CO2 adsorbate at height 2.0. Finally write combined CIF to file and output path.

We need to use enumerate_slabs_text with Si CIF, miller_index (1,1,1), min_slab_size 12, min_vacuum_size 5. Then choose slab 0. Then get adsorption sites. Then choose site. Then add adsorbate.
